title: Ben Rich and reverse-engineered aerospace

plain: Ben Rich, a former head of Lockheed's secret aircraft division, is said to have hinted that some American aerospace technology came from studying craft that were not made by humans. That is reverse engineering: taking something apart to learn how it was built. A former scientist at DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, named John Blitch, raises Rich's claims with Michels. He gives no source and adds no detail of his own beyond saying "I have no reason to call Ben Rich a liar."
